name: ExistsContDiffBumpBase
y_nonneg
result.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_4 : BorelSpace E] (D : ℝ) (x : E), 0 ≤ ExistsContDiffBumpBase.y D x
result.informal_name: Non-Negativity of Bump Function Base Component
result.informal_description: For any real number $D$ and any element $x$ in the finite-dimensional real normed vector space $E$, the function $y(D, x)$ is non-negative, i.e., $0 \leq y(D, x)$.

name: SmoothBumpFunction
nonneg
result.informal_name: A smooth bump function is non-negative
result.informal_description: Let $M$ be a finite-dimensional real manifold and let $f: M \to \mathbb{R}$ be a smooth bump function. Then for all $x \in M$, we have $f(x) \geq 0$.

name: ContDiffBump
nonneg
result.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : HasContDiffBump E] {c : E}
  (f : ContDiffBump c) {x : E}, 0 ≤ ↑f x
result.informal_name: Non-Negativity of Continuously Differentiable Bump Functions
result.informal_description: For any continuously differentiable bump function $f$ constructed via the $\text{ContDiffBump}$ structure, the function value satisfies $0 \leq f(x)$ for all $x$ in the normed vector space $E$.

name: MeasureTheory
lintegral_union_le
result.signature: (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s t : Set α) : ∫⁻ a in s ∪ t, f a ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ + ∫⁻ a in t, f a ∂μ
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} (f : α → ENNReal) (s t : Set α),
  ∫⁻ (a : α) in s ∪ t, f a ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ (a : α) in s, f a ∂μ + ∫⁻ (a : α) in t, f a ∂μ
result.value:
:= by
  rw [← lintegral_add_measure]
  exact lintegral_mono' (restrict_union_le _ _) le_rfl
result.informal_name: Subadditivity of Lebesgue Integral for Non-Negative Functions Over Set Unions
result.informal_description: For a measurable space $\alpha$, a measure $\mu$, and a non-negative measurable function $f : \alpha \to [0, \infty]$, the Lebesgue integral of $f$ over the union of measurable sets $s$ and $t$ satisfies the inequality $\int_{s \cup t} f \, d\mu \leq \int_s f \, d\mu + \int_t f \, d\mu$.

name: ENNReal
tsum_biUnion_le
result.signature: {ι : Type*} (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Set α) : ∑' x : ⋃ i ∈ s, t i, f x ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑' x : t i, f x
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_4} (f : α → ENNReal) (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Set α),
  ∑' (x : ↑(⋃ i ∈ s, t i)), f ↑x ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑' (x : ↑(t i)), f ↑x
result.value:
:=
  (tsum_biUnion_le_tsum f s t).trans_eq (Finset.tsum_subtype s fun i => ∑' x : t i, f x)
result.informal_name: Sum over Finite Union Inequality in Extended Non-Negative Reals
result.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to [0, \infty] $, finite set $ s \subseteq \iota $, and family of sets $ t_i \subseteq \alpha $ indexed by $ i \in s $, the infinite sum of $ f(x) $ over the union $ \bigcup_{i \in s} t_i $ satisfies $ \sum'_{x \in \bigcup_{i \in s} t_i} f(x) \leq \sum_{i \in s} \sum'_{x \in t_i} f(x) $.

name: ENNReal
tsum_biUnion_le_tsum
result.signature: {ι : Type*} (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Set ι) (t : ι → Set α) : ∑' x : ⋃ i ∈ s, t i, f x ≤ ∑' i : s, ∑' x : t i, f x
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_4} (f : α → ENNReal) (s : Set ι) (t : ι → Set α),
  ∑' (x : ↑(⋃ i ∈ s, t i)), f ↑x ≤ ∑' (i : ↑s) (x : ↑(t ↑i)), f ↑x
result.value:
:=
  calc
    ∑' x : ⋃ i ∈ s, t i, f x = ∑' x : ⋃ i : s, t i, f x := tsum_congr_set_coe _ <| by simp
    _ ≤ ∑' i : s, ∑' x : t i, f x := tsum_iUnion_le_tsum _ _
result.informal_name: Union Sum Inequality for Extended Non-Negative Reals
result.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to [0, \infty] $, any set $ s $ of indices, and any family of sets $ t_i $ indexed by $ i \in s $, the infinite sum of $ f(x) $ over the union $ \bigcup_{i \in s} t_i $ is less than or equal to the infinite sum over $ i \in s $ of the infinite sum of $ f(x) $ over each $ t_i $. Formally, $ \sum'_{x \in \bigcup_{i \in s} t_i} f(x) \leq \sum'_{i \in s} \sum'_{x \in t_i} f(x) $.
